title: Fuzzing the Constitution: Random Principle Perturbation

original_idea.body:
# Fuzzing the Constitution

**Problem:** CAI prompts are brittle; small wording changes may produce large safety swings.

**Direction:** Generate many small perturbations of principles, run self-critique on a fixed harmful set, log which cause large jumps in harmful-output rate.

**Why it matters:** Surfaces fragile constitutional wording. Inference-only.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2502.04134; arXiv:2507.06253.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Surfacing fragile constitutional wording hardens a widely used alignment method.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Inference-only perturbation fuzzing on a self-critique loop; beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused fragility-ranking; needs perturbation generator and probe set.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open critique prompts, inference-only; independent-friendly robustness infrastructure.

novelty.reasoning: Prompt-sensitivity is known but systematic fuzzing of constitutional principles may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Prompt sensitivity known; constitution-fuzzing framing may be open.
